question: Walking at (3)/(4) of his normal speed from his home, Manish is 20 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 3/4 ⇒ Time = 4/3

Extra time = 1/3 of usual time

1/3 of usual time = 20 min

Usual time = 20 × 3 = 60 min

**∴ Answer = 60 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 3/4 of normal

Delay = 20 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New time = T × (4/3)

⇒ Delay = (4T/3 − T)

⇒ = T/3

⇒ T/3 = 20

⇒ T = 60 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 60 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation

If speed decreases, time increases proportionally.

Delay Concept

Delay = New time − Original time.

Shortcut Rule

Extra fraction of time = (1 − speed ratio) ÷ speed ratio.
